components.license: MIT; contains code partially based on the VOICEVOX engine (LGPL-3.0), a C# port of SimpleEnunu's f0_smoother (MIT) and a Deque implementation matching Nito.Collections.Deque (MIT); embeds data of unverified provenance

components.source: https://github.com/stakira/OpenUtau (tag 0.1.565, built unmodified from that commit)
components.obligations: MIT notice and the upstream MIT/Apache notices of the ported code (shipped). LGPL-3.0: OpenUtau.Core.Voicevox (VoicevoxRenderer, VoicevoxUtils, VoicevoxConfig) states it is 'partially based on the VOICEVOX engine' (LGPL_LICENSE), so OpenUtau.Core.dll is distributed with the LGPL text (shipped), as a separate replaceable DLL, built unmodified from the public commit named above; the written statement is in NOTICES.txt. Embedded data: the g2p models (arpabet, arpabet-plus, de, es, fr, it, ja-mono, ko, pt, ru) were contributed to the MIT repository by named contributors (e.g. commits 22e0c887, 2d0fcbe7, 8b8104ae, ed3267b9), the Vogen models and yue.csv by the maintainer in 2022 (e6486acc, 5b698e5b); none carries a licence statement, and the training data or dictionaries they derive from (for example CMUdict for the English model) are not named. The CREPE tiny.onnx model is MIT (Jong Wook Kim; licence shipped).
components.notes: Release blocker until a person (1) confirms the LGPL handling of the VOICEVOX-derived classes and (2) the owner of the embedded g2p/Vogen data is asked to confirm it may be redistributed, or those features are removed from a BLT-specific build of OpenUtau.Core (which would no longer be the unmodified upstream binary).

The Data\*.template.yaml files are contributor-authored within the MIT repository.
components.notes: Residual risk: the in-repository authorship statements are not independently verified.
